column1: # NGFW appliance disk layout (docs/09-os-packages.md §7). Labels as allocated in docs/status/wave-BC-numbers.md "P14":
# the ISO installer (P14), the disk images (F-images) and the A/B upgrade (F-ab-upgrade) all find partitions by them.
# Change it only through P14. Columns are whitespace separated:
#   label   GPT partition name AND filesystem label (FAT labels: upper case, at most 11 characters)
#   size    <n>G = n GiB (curtin units are binary); "rest" = the remainder of the disk (last row only)
#   mount   mount point, "-" = never mounted and not in fstab
#   role    esp | root-active | root-reserved | log | pg | data
#   luks    "luks" = on dm-crypt when the image is built with --luks, "-" = never encrypted
# A 1 MiB BIOS boot partition (GPT type bios_grub, no label, no filesystem) precedes these rows so that legacy BIOS can
# boot the GPT disk; it is partition 1 and the rows below are partitions 2..7 in this order.
# Fixed part: 1 MiB + 81 GiB; the installer refuses disks smaller than 96 GiB (ngfw-data gets at least ~15 GiB).
